snippet.title: Entangled: Game Demo Teaser
snippet.description:
Follow me on twitter to see game updates: https://twitter.com/boi_bim
Follow me on Itch to keep up with build releases: https://bimboi.itch.io
Like and Subscribe for more videos :)

Support me and Entangled: https://www.patreon.com/bimboidev
Support Michael who makes all the music for entangled: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCY7Kh7w6Kqb9J1RPAhGN29g

Apologies for the delay in the video posting, I never stopped working on the game. I just really wanted to focus on getting a tangible thing for people to try out and interact with!

Once again the demo and video will be up sometime this coming Tuesday, 2/22/2022. My time zone is EST.
